details:
Project Details

BEYOND X is an interactive web platform designed to help users explore and understand real astronomical observations from NASA’s SPHEREx mission. The project transforms complex scientific data into an immersive, user-friendly experience that allows users to visualize how celestial objects change over time.

The platform integrates real SPHEREx observation data, including observation images, coordinates, spectral bands, and observation metadata. Users can navigate through observations, explore different regions of the sky, and compare observations across multiple time periods. A visual comparison system allows users to identify important changes such as brightness variations, moving objects, and unusual observations through swipe-based and side-by-side comparison tools.

One of the key features of BEYOND X is ASTRA, an AI-powered assistant that supports both Arabic and English. ASTRA helps users understand observations by providing simple explanations, guided exploration, voice interaction, and contextual information about NASA observations. This makes the platform accessible not only to astronomy enthusiasts but also to students and members of the public with no scientific background.

The intended impact of the project is to make astronomical discovery more accessible and engaging. Scientific datasets can often be difficult to understand, especially for non-specialists. BEYOND X bridges this gap by combining data visualization, AI-powered guidance, interactive storytelling, and real NASA observations into a single experience.

Technologies Used

  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • JavaScript (ES6)
  • Three.js
  • GSAP
  • NASA SPHEREx DR1 Observation Data
  • NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)
  • AI-powered voice and interaction systems
  • Responsive web technologies

Creativity and Innovation

What makes BEYOND X unique is its combination of real SPHEREx scientific observations, cinematic visual storytelling, interactive time-based comparison, and an AI guide that simplifies complex astronomical information. Instead of presenting raw scientific data through traditional dashboards, the project creates an immersive exploration experience that helps users discover and understand changes in the universe in a visually engaging and intuitive way.

Team Considerations

During development, the team focused on:

  • Accessibility for non-scientific users
  • Bilingual support (Arabic and English)
  • Integration of real NASA data
  • Ease of understanding astronomical changes
  • Interactive visual comparison tools
  • User engagement through AI guidance
  • Professional and immersive user experience

By combining scientific authenticity, accessibility, and interactive exploration, BEYOND X helps users discover what lies beyond human vision while promoting public engagement with space science and NASA mission data.
